rows.title: Efficacy and Safety of Phyllanthus Emblica and Tinospora Cordifolia in Postadolescence Acne: A Randomized Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Trial.
rows.journal: Journal of integrative and complementary medicine
rows.focus: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled dose-ranging trial in 88 adults with acne. Hematologic, hepatic, and renal safety parameters remained within reference ranges and no serious or treatment-related adverse events were reported; efficacy signals were not definitive.

rows.title: Traditional Chinese medicine-induced cardiac adverse reactions: a critical review of current evidence, knowledge gaps, and pharmacovigilance strategies.
rows.focus: Critical review of cardiac adverse reactions linked to traditional Chinese medicine, emphasizing sparse pharmacokinetic interaction data, underused real-world evidence, lack of specific biomarkers, and the need for stronger pharmacovigilance.

rows.title: Natural history of sleep before and after total joint arthroplasty is poor and unimproved by melatonin: A randomized controlled study.
rows.focus: Randomized study of perioperative melatonin versus placebo in 48 arthroplasty patients. Melatonin increased sleep duration in hip arthroplasty patients but did not improve overall sleep-quality scores, opioid use, or recovery.

rows.title: Dietary melatonin, chronotype, and night eating syndrome in relation to sleep quality among adults.
rows.focus: Cross-sectional study of 325 adults found eveningness and night-eating behaviors associated with poorer sleep quality, while estimated dietary melatonin intake was not associated with sleep quality after adjustment. Findings are observational and hypothesis-generating.
